_comment: Brackets confirmed against CRA. Ontario has NOT published its 2026 package,
so every amount below is estimated from the 2025 figure — which is itself now
verified against ON428 — indexed at Ontario's own 1.9% factor, derived from
the confirmed brackets (53,891 / 52,886). The federal 2.0% does not apply.
Replace these when Ontario publishes, around January 2027.

income_tax.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA, Current year tax rates and income brackets 2026 (canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/tax-rates-brackets/current-year.html). Thresholds and rates both confirmed.

credit_rate.source: VERIFIED 2026-08-16 against CRA/Ontario Ministry of Finance, Form ON428 2025 (5006-C) and Worksheet ON428 (5006-D) for 2025; statutory rate, unchanged for 2026.

bpa.source: ESTIMATED: the 2025 figure of 12747, verified against CRA/Ontario Ministry of Finance, Form ON428 2025 (5006-C) and Worksheet ON428 (5006-D), indexed at Ontario's own 1.9% factor (derived from the confirmed 2026 brackets: 53,891 / 52,886). Ontario has not published its 2026 package.

care_rate_base_tier1.source: CARE rate (Schedule ON479-A) for adjusted family income of $20,000 or less. Refundable, and a step function. The CARE thresholds are statutory and unindexed. CONFIRM whether the income measured is net income before or after the child care deduction — Freshet uses line 23600, which is after.

care_tier1_ceiling.source: Top of the flat 75% CARE band. Statutory, unindexed.

care_rate_base_tier2.source: CARE rate at $20,000, from which the second band steps down.

care_tier2_ceiling.source: Top of the second CARE band. Statutory, unindexed.

care_tier2_step.source: Between $20,000 and $40,000 the CARE rate falls 2 points per $2,500 or portion.

care_rate_base_tier3.source: CARE rate at $40,000, from which the third band steps down.

care_tier3_ceiling.source: Top of the third CARE band. Statutory, unindexed.

care_tier3_step.source: Between $40,000 and $60,000 the CARE rate falls 2 points per $5,000 or portion.

care_rate_base_tier4.source: CARE rate at $60,000, from which the fourth band steps down.

care_tier4_ceiling.source: CARE is fully phased out above $150,000 of adjusted family income. Statutory, unindexed.

care_tier4_step.source: Between $60,000 and $150,000 the CARE rate falls 2 points per $3,600 or portion.

care_step_reduction.source: Each step reduces the CARE rate by two percentage points.
